svg.text: The political order at the height of the Mongol incursion — early-to-mid 1242, the Horde still in Hungary
Principal powers only. Frontiers are indicative approximations, not surveyed borders; minor lordships consolidated into their overlords.
Projection: Albers equal-area (standard parallels 36°N / 62°N). Coastlines: Natural Earth 1:50m. Political boundaries hand-reconstructed for c. 1242 and deliberately generalised.

Note the year is one in motion: the Mongol host withdrew eastward through the Balkans by mid-1242; Rum (about to fall at Köse Dağ, 1243) and Georgia are shown as still-standing though under mounting Mongol pressure.
